name: Dentin Dysplasia-Sclerotic Bones Syndrome
aliases: Dentin Dysplasia with Sclerotic Bone Changes
Dentin Dysplasia Type I with Osteosclerosis

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Dentin Dysplasia-Sclerotic Bones Syndrome

criteria.description: Presence of dentin dysplasia characterized by rootless teeth and obliterated pulp chambers
Radiographic evidence of generalized osteosclerosis affecting multiple bones
Positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of both dentin dysplasia and radiographic skeletal sclerosis
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory

pathognomonic.symptomName: Rootless teeth with obliterated pulp chambers
pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic dental abnormality diagnostic of dentin dysplasia

pathognomonic.symptomName: Generalized osteosclerosis of long bones and skull
pathognomonic.notes: Diffuse increased bone density seen on imaging
searchTerms: thickened bones of arms, legs, skull

occasional.notes: Subtle changes such as midface hypoplasia

occasional.symptomName: Skeletal deformities (e.g. bowing of long bones)

occasional.notes: Due to pulp chamber obliteration and necrosis

searchTerms: hearing loss from bone growth in ear

rare.notes: Severe cases may present with fractures

rare.symptomName: Neurological symptoms secondary to cranial sclerosis
searchTerms: nerve problems from skull bone thickening
neurological issues due to skull sclerosis
brain symptoms from cranial bone changes

laboratory: Normal serum calcium and phosphate levels
imaging: Radiographs showing rootless teeth with obliterated pulp chambers
Diffuse osteosclerosis of long bones, skull, and pelvis on X-ray
Bone scintigraphy may show increased uptake in sclerotic areas
genetic: Possible mutations in genes involved in dentin formation and bone metabolism (specific gene not well defined)
other: Histopathology of bone shows increased bone density with reduced marrow spaces

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of opalescent teeth with normal or short roots
Generalized bone sclerosis with bone marrow failure

redFlags: Early onset of multiple pathological fractures
Severe premature tooth loss with dental abscesses
Neurological deficits due to cranial nerve compression
references: Wright JT, et al. Dentin Dysplasia: A Review. Oral Diseases. 2015.
Riminucci M, et al. Osteosclerosis and Dentin Dysplasia: Clinical and Molecular Features. Bone. 2018.
